checklist_item: Confirm the correct aircraft effectivity and approved task instructions
Install landing gear ground lockpins
Extend the flaps to access the main gear support area
Depressurize hydraulic systems A and B
Operate the brakes to depressurize the brake accumulators
Open the applicable landing gear circuit breakers and apply safety identifiers
Remove the applicable hydraulic access panel
Remove the main gear shock strut doors
Deflate and compress the shock strut according to the AMM warning
Install the main gear oleo lock assembly
Jack the aircraft according to the approved jacking procedure
Mark the tire footprint position
Remove the main gear damper
Position suitable containers for hydraulic fluid drainage
Disconnect the hydraulic lines from the main landing gear
Cap and plug all disconnected hydraulic lines and connections
Disconnect and secure the applicable electrical harnesses
Remove or disconnect the main landing gear actuator assembly as specified
Support the main landing gear with the approved installation dolly
Disconnect the drag strut and associated attachments according to the AMM sequence
Remove the trunnion link attachments using the specified tooling
Roll the main landing gear clear of the aircraft
Inspect and prepare the attachment areas and components
Position the replacement main landing gear beneath the aircraft
Install the trunnion link and drag strut attachments in the specified sequence
Install the main landing gear actuator assembly
Reconnect the electrical harnesses and secure their clamps
Reconnect the hydraulic lines and secure their clamps
Install the main gear damper and shock strut doors
Service the shock strut according to the approved procedure
Restore the hydraulic system and applicable circuit breakers
Perform the required landing gear operational and leak checks
Confirm all tools materials locks and protective devices are accounted for
Record completion and obtain the required maintenance sign-off
Confirm the correct fuel boost pump location and aircraft effectivity
Confirm all fuel boost pump switches are OFF
Confirm the fuel crossfeed valve and engine fuel shutoff valves are closed
Open the applicable fuel system circuit breakers and apply DO-NOT-CLOSE identifiers
Obtain access to the applicable fuel boost pump
Manually close the applicable fuel boost pump removal valve
Disconnect the electrical connector from the fuel boost pump
Position a suitable container and drain residual fuel from the pump
Support the fuel boost pump
Release and move the pump mounting clamps clear
Remove the fuel boost pump from its mounting face
Clean the pump and mounting flange mating surfaces with approved materials
Prepare the mating surfaces for the required electrical bond
Inspect the flame arrestor vent port
Install new lubricated O-rings in the pump grooves
Prime the replacement fuel boost pump according to the AMM
Position the fuel boost pump on its mounting face
Install and secure the pump mounting clamps
Reconnect the fuel boost pump electrical connector
Check the electrical bond between the pump and aircraft structure
Manually open the fuel boost pump removal valve
Verify that the fuel boost pump is correctly primed
Restore the applicable fuel system circuit breakers
Perform the required pump operational and fuel leak checks
Install the applicable fuel boost pump access panel
Confirm the pump removal valve is open before closing the access area
Remove safety identifiers and restore the aircraft configuration
Record completion and obtain the required maintenance sign-off
Confirm the correct battery type and aircraft effectivity
Set the battery switch to OFF
Loosen the connector hand knob and disconnect the battery plug
Loosen and lower the two battery hold-down knobs
Remove the covered battery and holder from the battery tray
Loosen the wing nuts and remove the battery from its holder
Check that the battery temperature switch is correctly centered
Place the covered replacement battery in its holder
Align the battery cover correctly
Secure the battery with the wing nuts and T-bolts
Slide the battery into position against the temperature switch
Confirm the temperature switch contacts the battery case correctly
Raise and tighten the two battery hold-down knobs
Inspect the battery connector for arcing pitting and corrosion
Replace or repair an unacceptable connector according to the approved instructions
Press the battery plug onto the terminal pins
Tighten the battery connector hand knob
Configure the applicable circuit breaker and battery switch for the battery test
Select BAT on the DC meter selector
Verify approximately 24 volts and observe the discharge current
Restore the applicable circuit breakers
Observe the battery charging current when AC power is available
Set the battery switch to OFF
Confirm the work area is clear and the battery is secure
Record completion and obtain the required maintenance sign-off
